kjv.text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

bsb.text: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

web.text: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

leads.kjv: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

flow.say: Henry shows that Paul calls Christians to rejoice in the Lord always, making this a duty of great consequence.
Our joy must center on God himself, and even our difficult thoughts can be turned to delight in him.
This rejoicing applies at all times and in all conditions, even when we suffer or face hardship in serving God.
Paul repeats this command because joy in God is so important that Christians need to hear it again and again.

morning.say: Carry into today Henry's reminder that God himself is enough to give you joy, no matter what happens.
morning.phrase: There is enough in God to furnish us with matter of joy in the worst circumstance on earth
